title: US median home prices have cooled from their 2022 peak but stay far above 2020
intro: Median sales price of houses sold in the United States, selected quarters. Prices peaked at $442,600 in Q4 2022 and have slipped for three straight years to $403,200 in Q1 2026 — still about a quarter above the $322,600 recorded at the start of 2020.

source.name: U.S. Census Bureau and HUD, via FRED (MSPUS)

altInsight: US median home sale prices climbed from $275,200 in early 2014 to a peak of $442,600 in late 2022, then eased for three straight years to $403,200 by early 2026 — still roughly a quarter above the pre-pandemic level of $322,600 in 2020.
